narrator.text: Next into the den: a government minister, asking for two billion pounds.

minister.text: Two billion pounds. Every teenager in the country, taken round a prison. Scare them straight. ... I've got a good feeling.

nurse.text: One ward. Six months. If readmissions don't fall by a tenth, you stop paying me.

badcode.text: And how will you know it works? ... I'm in.
